categories.main_business_segments: Tex-Ray Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in textile manufacturing and garment production. Its main business segments include woven and knitted fabrics, metal fibers, ready-made garments, and home textiles. The company also focuses on functional and eco-friendly textiles, smart wearable clothing, and sportswear.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes patented eco-friendly wet printing technology that reduces energy and water consumption compared to traditional dyeing. It develops functional fibers such as metal fiber blends, conductive and high-temperature resistant fabrics, and smart textiles. Production incorporates automation, digital fabric and pattern systems, and sustainable manufacturing processes aligned with international standards like ISO 14001.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tex-Ray serves international brand customers and global apparel retailers, providing one-stop services from design to garment manufacturing. Key markets include the United States, South Africa, Europe, Japan, and emerging markets in Southeast Asia and Africa. The company targets customers demanding functional, sustainable, and smart textile products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with production bases and sales operations in Taiwan, China, Vietnam, Southeast Asia, Africa (notably Swaziland), North America (including Mexico), and Europe. It strategically adjusts production locations to optimize costs and comply with trade policies, focusing on regional market demands.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tex-Ray operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the textile supply chain, including fabric weaving, dyeing, finishing, and garment manufacturing. It integrates upstream raw material sourcing through partnerships but focuses on value-added textile processing and apparel production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in sustainable and functional textiles, including eco-friendly printing, antimicrobial fibers, smart wearable technology, and high-performance sportswear. It invests in ODM capabilities, digitalization of production, automation, and global supply chain optimization. Tex-Ray emphasizes ESG compliance and innovation to meet evolving market and regulatory demands.
categories.revenue_model: Tex-Ray generates revenue primarily through product sales of textiles and garments to global brand customers. It offers integrated services from fabric development to finished apparel, including ODM and OEM manufacturing. The company also derives income from licensing proprietary textile technologies and branded functional fiber products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with textile and garment manufacturers from China, South Korea, Hong Kong, India, and emerging Southeast Asian countries. Tex-Ray positions itself as a leader in functional and smart textiles with strong R&D and global supply chain management, differentiating through innovation and sustainability to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, Tex-Ray reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$5.03 billion, a 10.58% increase from the prior year, with a net profit of NT$79 million. The company has shown recovery from prior challenges and maintains steady growth supported by global market expansion and product innovation. Total assets exceed NT$8.7 billion with ongoing investments in R&D and automation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tex-Ray offers unique value through patented eco-friendly textile technologies, high-performance functional fabrics, and smart wearable solutions. Its global integrated supply chain enables rapid response and cost-effective production. The company emphasizes sustainability, product quality, and innovation to meet stringent international standards and customer demands for environmentally responsible and technologically advanced textiles.
